excerpt.zh:
[Root.GetName]研究部门的首席科学官失踪了。

他们的私人赞助的科研船试验机也不见了。

[Root.Capital.GetName]科学界一片哗然。
excerpt.en:
The Head of the [Root.GetName]'s Research Department has gone missing.

Along with their privately-funded, highly experimental prototype Science Ship.

The incident has the scientific community on [Root.Capital.GetName] in an uproar.

scope.zh: 已对照游戏文件核对入口与触发、条件、选项与结果、分类，并撰写双语导读。
scope.en: Root and trigger, conditions, options and outcomes, and category checked against the game files; bilingual guide written.

label.zh: 进入前两个搜索星系：死胡同
label.en: Enter the first two search systems: dead end

label.zh: 搜完三个星系中的最后一个：找到科学官
label.en: Search the last of the three systems: scientist found
The probes are destroyed by another empire

label.zh: 舰队进入倒数第二个目标星系
label.en: A fleet enters the penultimate target system
The pirates are destroyed by another empire

label.zh: 舰队进入最后一个标记星系
label.en: A fleet enters the final marked system

label.zh: 探测器：自己击毁 / 他国击毁
label.en: Probes: destroyed by us / by someone else

note.zh: 付钱（150能量，需和平主义或物质主义伦理）得 country.1041；开战得 country.1042，击毁海盗后 country.1045。
note.en: Paying (150 energy, pacifist or materialist ethics) gives country.1041; fighting gives country.1042 and, once the pirates die, country.1045.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]研究部门的首席科学官失踪了。

他们的私人赞助的科研船试验机也不见了。

[Root.Capital.GetName]科学界一片哗然。
texts.en:
The Head of the [Root.GetName]'s Research Department has gone missing.

Along with their privately-funded, highly experimental prototype Science Ship.

The incident has the scientific community on [Root.Capital.GetName] in an uproar.

notes.zh: 触发：游戏开始后由开局事件闸门 country.900 抽取（events/game_start.txt:15 在460±60天后触发；events/country_events_2.txt:17-66 为按权重的随机列表，四条开局故事互斥，另有69%什么都不发生）。权重仅1（其余开局故事各为10）；需人类玩家、非集群意识、研究总督是科学家，且全局没有进行中的“浪迹星涯”（country_events_2.txt:360-371）。该科学家被放逐（exile_leader_as）。
notes.en: Trigger: After game start the starting-event gate country.900 draws it (events/game_start.txt:15 fires it after 460±60 days; events/country_events_2.txt:17-66 is a weighted random list: the four opening stories are mutually exclusive and 69% of the weight is "nothing happens"). Weight only 1 (the others 10); needs a human player, non-gestalt, a scientist research councilor and no other Wanderlust in progress (country_events_2.txt:360-371). The scientist is exiled (exile_leader_as).

texts.zh:
首席科学官——准确来说应该是前首席科学官——还没有找到。但是一些关于科研船试验机以及长官的私人研究的消息却已经传到了我们的耳朵里。虽然有一些太过离谱，但显而易见的是尽快寻回首席关乎着[Root.GetName]的利益。

情报日志已更新。
texts.en:
The whereabouts of the Head - now technically the former Head of Research - have yet to be ascertained. Certain details regarding the prototype Science Ship and the Head's private research have reached our ears, and while some aspects seem too fantastical to be true, it is clear that it is in the [Root.GetName]'s interest to find and recover the Chair as soon as possible.

The Situation Log has been updated.

tooltips.zh: 开启“浪迹星涯：叛变科学官”事件链
tooltips.en: Begins the Wanderlust: Rogue Scientist Event Chain

label.zh: 进入前两个搜索星系：死胡同
label.en: Enter the first two search systems: dead end

label.zh: 搜完三个星系中的最后一个：找到科学官
label.en: Search the last of the three systems: scientist found

texts.zh:
首席科学官并不在这个星系之内。

这一趟要不就彻底是白忙活，要不就是线索早已经断了。
texts.en:
The Research Head is not in this system.

Either the lead was a dud, or the trail has gone cold.

texts.zh:
科学家的船就在这个星系里——如果没猜错的话。

我们没法通过探测器确定他们的位置，不过他们主动呼叫了我们。把他们的信号接到[Root.Capital.GetName]。
texts.en:
The Researcher's ship is in this system - we think.

We are unable to lock in their position on sensors, but they are hailing us. Patching them through to [Root.Capital.GetName].

texts.zh:
[Root.GetRulerTitle]，鄙人向您传达我们诚挚的问候。

我估计你不是单纯来寒暄问候的吧？
texts.en:
Greetings and salutations, [Root.GetRulerTitle].

I take it this is not a social call?

label.en: What is the meaning of this?

responses.zh:
您应该想问我从[Root.GetName]上消失的事。

我只是离开一小会，仅此而已。我在寻找真实之窗。但显然我并没找到。

它也不在这里。我必须继续我的研究了。不过我可不会带着这些找到的无人机。
responses.en:
I take it you are referring to my disappearance from [Root.GetName] space.

I needed some time away, is all. Well. Rather, I am looking for the Window. And the Window is certainly not there.

It is not here either. I must continue my search. I will not be bringing these drones I found, though.

label.zh: 我们可以派船护送你回家。
label.en: We can assign ships to escort you home.
You will return to the capital at once.

texts.zh:
我现在不想回家。

但是，为了表示我的诚意，请收下这些无人机吧，作为我送给[Root.GetName]的礼物。这些无人机是我在这个星系的外围发现的。经过彻底修理过后，我才发现它们根本不适合用作研究探测。
texts.en:
I have no interest in returning home at present.

But please, as a token of my goodwill, take these drones. A donation to the [Root.GetName]. I found them drifting on the outskirts of this system, and only after extensive repairs did I realize that they are utterly unfit to function as research probes.

texts.zh:
首席再次神秘地消失了。

不过他们的确留下了一些无人机。这些无人机装备了武器，而且正在启动！
texts.en:
The Chair has vanished, inexplicably, yet again.

However, they did leave a number of drones behind, as promised. The drones are armed, and their weapons are powering up!

label.en: The probes are destroyed by another empire

title.zh: 浪迹星涯：毁坏的无人机

texts.zh:
这些无人机的敌我识别系统的模组被拆除了，应该是首席干的。不过它们的威胁评估处理器还完好无损。由于此人的破坏行为，威胁等级有些升高。

首席科学官不像是想让它们攻击我们，但是它们很好地掩护了首席，让其成功逃走了。

查看情报日志的特殊项目，以获得首席最后一次出现的位置。
texts.en:
The drones' IFF modules had been removed, likely a result of the Head Researcher's repairs, but their threat assessment processors remained intact and somewhat stressed by the Head's invasive procedures.

It is unlikely that the head meant for the drones to attack us, but fact remains that they covered the scientist's escape nicely.

Consult the Situation Log for a Special Project to track the Head from their last known location.

texts.zh:
随着首席科学官从这个星系毫无征兆的离去，大量令人困惑的残余能量信号随着太阳风被投射出去。

但愿彻底研究这些能量能帮我们找出首席科学家的下一个目的地，甚至，如果有必要，让我们更容易地追踪他。
texts.en:
The Chairperson's unseen departure from this system resulted in a perplexing mass of residual energy signatures being cast upon the solar winds.

Hopefully a complete analysis of these energies should point us to the Chairperson's next destination, and if need be, make them easier to track in the future.

title.zh: 浪迹星涯：特殊项目已完成

texts.zh:
我们已经破译了首席留下的科研船上的能源信息，可以再度对其展开追踪。

查看情报日志以获得更多细节。
texts.en:
Having decoded the intricate web of energy signatures left behind by the Chair's elusive Science Ship, we are on their trail once again.

Consult the Situation Log for details.

label.zh: 舰队进入倒数第二个目标星系
label.en: A fleet enters the penultimate target system

texts.zh: 首席再次消失，但这一次他们留下了一些踪迹。
texts.en: The Chair has vanished again, but this time they left a trail.

texts.zh:
首席的科研船神出鬼没，侦测起来相当困难，但这还不是最难的。

传感器上显示的数据令人不解，上面显示首席的船两侧各有一艘虎视眈眈的护卫舰。

首席物理学家正在向我们致意。
texts.en:
The ephemeral Science Ship remains difficult to detect, but apparently not difficult enough.

The blur of confused sensor readings that we have come to associate with the Head's ship is flanked on both sides by a pair of rather nasty-looking corvettes.

The Physicist Head is hailing us.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetRulerTitle]，您好。

请允许我向[Root.GetSpeciesName]的舰队致以热烈欢迎。恐怕我的突然出现激怒了这个星系的外星生物，现在他们的飞船把我包围了。

如果您能帮忙弥补一下我的失礼行为，那就再好不过了。事情解决后，我会很乐意与你们分享我的探险经历。
texts.en:
Greetings, [Root.GetRulerTitle].

[Root.GetSpeciesName] ships are a most welcome sight. I fear my own sudden appearance in this system may have angered the alien beings aboard the ships that now surround mine.

Any assistance in rectifying whatever faux pas I may have committed would be most appreciated. I will gladly share with you the nature of my expedition once this matter is settled.

responses.zh:
跑？我只是离开而已。

[Root.GetRulerTitle]，我知道你们都不太喜欢我的行为。但我不能让[Root.GetSpeciesName]科学界没完没了的派别斗争危害到我的研究。

而且，有些研究也需要实地考察。一直如此。
responses.en:
Run? I left.

I realize you are none too pleased with my actions, [Root.GetRulerTitle], but I could not risk my work being mired in the petty politics of the [Root.GetSpeciesName] scientific community.

Besides, I had some research to do in the field. Still do.

label.zh: 先跟我们讲讲关于真实之窗的事。
label.en: Tell us more about this Window, first.

responses.zh:
在这种节骨眼上，我不太方便讲述细节。我不太想，嗯，让自己看起来像个傻瓜。万一最后证明我是错的呢？

但是我们也许最后都会变成全息影像。这又是否值得呢？
responses.en:
I would be loath to go into details at this juncture. Would not, ah, want to look the fool. Should it turn out that I am mistaken.

But we may all turn out to be holograms in the end. Would it not be worth it?

label.zh: 我们会帮你摆平局面的。
label.en: We will try to get you out of this mess.

texts.zh:
滚开！是我们先找到这艘破烂幽灵船的。

谁先看见就是谁的，不是谁先登船就是谁的。它是我们的，不是你们的。而且它的舰长还死了。
texts.en:
Get lost! We found the rotten ghost-ship first.

Once we figure out how to see it proper-like, it's as good as boarded. And ours. Not yours. And its captain dead.

label.zh: 外星人渣，敢跟我们结梁子，你早晚要后悔。
label.en: You will rue the day you crossed us, alien scum.

responses.zh: 真是丑人多作怪。野蛮人，这不是我们第一次交锋了。
responses.en: Big words from someone so ugly. This isn't our first rodeo, bucko.

label.zh: 现在滚还能留你一条活路。
label.en: Leave now and you may yet live.

responses.zh:
虚张声势！丑八怪，这可不是你的领地。
这些星星是阳炎海盗的。
responses.en:
Empty threats! You are a long way from home, ugly.
The Sunblaster Pirates own these stars.

texts.zh:
150能量币？这价格估计都算不上家猪用剩的一点小零头，真狡猾。但是……

哎，这艘混账幽灵船带来的麻烦比它的好处还要多。

弟兄们！我们走！
texts.en:
150 Energy Credits? Hardly a drop in the domesti-beast's piss-bucket, ugly. But...

Bah, the filthy ghost-ship has been more trouble than it's worth anyway.

Skitskur'r! We out!

label.zh: 祈祷最好别再遇上我们吧，可怜虫。
label.en: Pray that we do not meet again, degenerates.

label.zh: 一切都是浮云，物质财富更是如此。
label.en: All things are fleeting, material wealth especially so.

label.zh: 金钱是万能的。如果做不到，说明你钱不够多。
label.en: Money talks. Sometimes you have to raise your voice.

texts.zh:
我忍不住听到了谈话中一些只言片语——毕竟他们是在开放频段上广播的。

我想交易进行得还算顺利。
texts.en:
I couldn't help but catch bits and pieces of that conversation - they were broadcasting on an open channel, after all.

I gather the transaction went smoothly.

label.zh: 确实如此。现在有话快说吧。

responses.zh:
噢，好的。

就是……我不用细枝末节来烦扰您了，[Root.GetRulerTitle]，但是有一种观念，一切皆为虚妄。或者说我们所认知的真实其实并非如此，至少并非完全如此，甚至比其他事物更接近于虚妄。这也就是说，这一切——包括我，[Root.GetRulerTitle]您自己，以及我们认为是不可动摇的宇宙法则——都只不过是光的把戏而已。这个宇宙不过是镜花水月，是映像，抑或是全息投影，或是棱镜。终究只不过是散射了真正现实的迷人光线罢了。

明白了吗？这些光一定是从某个地方来的。从真实之窗来的。
responses.en:
Oh yes, of course.
There is... I will not bore you with the details [Root.GetRulerTitle], but there is this idea, if you will, that nothing is real. Or that what we think is real is not, that it is less real, less so than something else. That this, this is all - I, you yourself [Root.GetRulerTitle], the very laws of nature we consider absolute - nothing but tricks of the light. The universe as a reflection, hologram, or prism, simply breaking the brilliant rays of the truly real.

See? The light has to come from somewhere. Through the Window.

label.en: You are to return to [Root.Capital.GetName] immediately.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetRulerTitle]，您心里很清楚我是不会回去的。

事实上，我也考虑过其他的可能性。我想我短时间内很可能无法回去了。

我手头的所有研究数据，只要我觉得对[Root.GetSpeciesName]的人们有用，我就会上传到[Root.Capital.GetName]的数据库中。但是和真实之窗有关的数据我会自己保留。现在我觉得自己还没有准备好。不过显然，没人准备好。

我得走了。
texts.en:
You know I will not, [Root.GetRulerTitle].
In fact, having had some time to consider additional possibilities, I believe there is a significant risk I will not be able to return within a reasonable timeframe.

I have taken the liberty of uploading whatever research data I have that may benefit the [Root.GetSpeciesName] people to the databases on [Root.Capital.GetName]. The data related to the Window stays with me, though. I am starting to think I am not ready; certainly no one else is.
I will be going now.

texts.zh:
简单查看了一下，首席的确说到做到。[Root.GetName]的物理学研究整体得到了小幅度的提升。

科学家又一次消失了，但是这一次，这个人的行踪在离开这个星系之前就被我们侦测到了。

如果他们想去寻找这个真实之窗，那么我们也会去。
查看情报日志以获得更多细节。
texts.en:
A quick check confirms the Head's claims, and the [Root.GetName] has enjoyed a small but not insignificant boost to our collective body of physics research.

The Researcher has vanished once again, but this time their course had been divined before they were even out of the system.

If they are headed for this Window, then so are we.
Consult the Situation Log for details.

label.zh: 舰队进入最后一个标记星系
label.en: A fleet enters the final marked system

texts.zh:
无论他们的动机是什么，必须把首席带回[Root.Capital.GetName]。

他们是要写下革命性的论文还是只受到纪律处分呢？我们拭目以待吧。
texts.en:
Whatever their motives may be, the Chair must be brought back to [Root.Capital.GetName].

Whether they will write a revolutionary thesis or simply face disciplinary action remains to be seen.

title.zh: 浪迹星涯：真实之窗开启

texts.zh:
科研船原型机第一次清楚地出现在了我们的传感器上。它以极近的距离围绕着这个星系的恒星运转，不过其他地方并没有什么特别的。

只需简单的光学扫描，这艘船的秘密就暴露无遗。它的船身设计十分普通，没有什么独到之处。上面有许多十字形的金属网格，像是交流电压控制下的电磁铁。只要足够接近恒星，飞船就能稍微扭曲恒星发出的射线，将它们缠绕于自身附近，把自己伪装起来。

这个科技理论上听起来不错，但是实际应用中却有一些明显的问题。由于暴露在恒星的辐射中太久，它的整套设配都已经被烤焦而且变得毫无用处。
texts.en:
For the first time, the prototype Science Ship is plainly visible on sensors. It is orbiting dangerously close to the system's star, but appears otherwise unremarkable.

A simple optical scan reveals the ship's secret. Its hull is a standard design altered without much subtlety, now crisscrossed by a lattice of metal filaments likely acting as electromagnets at alternating, tightly-controlled voltages. By staying close to a star the ship can weakly warp its stellar emissions, wrapping them around itself as a form of camouflage.

While conceptually interesting, the technique has obvious practical drawbacks, as evidenced by the entire set-up now having been fried and rendered useless by prolonged exposure to solar radiation.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetRulerTitle]，您好。

我有十足的理由相信你们将会继续追随我们。

所以我采取了一些措施。
texts.en:
Greetings, [Root.GetRulerTitle].

It seemed entirely reasonable to assume that you would follow, again.

So I did.

label.zh: 首席科学官，你想做什么？

responses.zh: 我想我已经找到真实之窗了。至少是一扇真实之窗。也许还会有更多。说不定我们的真身就在那里。说不定所有东西的真身就在那里。不得不承认，我脑子里一点概念也没有。我知道我获得的这些知识也没办法造福什么人。但是如果我就此打住的话，那也太不负责任了。
responses.en: I have found the Window, I think. A window, at least. There may be more. Do our true selves lie beyond? Does anything? I must confess that I haven't the faintest idea. I recognize that no one else may very well benefit from whatever knowledge I gain. But to stop here would be utterly irresponsible.

responses.zh:
我会试着穿过真实之窗，前往真实。显然，来自真实的光不单单只是通过这里。整个宇宙就像是一大块玻璃窗，我们只是其中的一小块扭曲，一小块瑕疵而已。我们的生命来源于我们之上的那种光辉。

这就是真实之窗，我相信它会开启的。
responses.en:
I will attempt to pass through the Window, into reality. The light of the real does not solely shine through here, of course. The entire universe is like a vast pane of glass, and we are the minute warps and imperfections in it, given life by the brilliance beyond.

This is the Window, because I believe it opens.

label.zh: 你的举动又鲁莽又危险。
label.en: Your actions are harebrained and dangerous.

texts.zh: 我的行为带来了诸多麻烦，为此我深感抱歉，[Root.GetRulerTitle]。但是，我不欠[Root.GetName]任何东西，对他们我已经仁至义尽。现在我必须完成我的使命了。您凭着强大的毅力一路跟来，我对您的帮助非常感激，但是从一开始我就已经下定决心，不会改变主意。
texts.en: I truly regret all the trouble I have caused, [Root.GetRulerTitle], I do. However, I owe nothing to the [Root.GetName], I have paid my dues in full and of this I am sure. You came after me of your own volition, and I am grateful for your help, but I made my intentions clear at the outset.

label.zh: 我们可以当这一切都没发生过，跟我们回家吧。
label.en: We will forget about the whole thing, just come home.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetRulerTitle]，窗口已开启。

再见。
texts.en:
The Window opens, [Root.GetRulerTitle].

Goodbye.

texts.zh:
科研船是空的。

所有用于舱外行动的衣服都好好地放在原处。飞船日志显示气闸从未向外打开过。

飞船还在围绕恒星运行，但现在受到[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]的控制。
texts.en:
The Science Ship is empty.

All suits for extra-vehicular activity remain in their pods, and the ship logs state that the airlock has never been exit-cycled.

The ship still orbits the star, but is now under [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] control.

tooltips.zh: 我们收回了科研船，飞船的基本功能仍可以正常使用。
tooltips.en: The Science Ship has been repossessed and its basic functions remain operational.

notes.zh: 结局：科学官的船恢复，设置完成旗标并移除全局旗标 wanderlust_ongoing（country_events_2.txt:1779-1808）。
notes.en: Ending: the scientist's ship is restored; the completion flag is set and the global flag wanderlust_ongoing removed (country_events_2.txt:1779-1808).

texts.zh:
这些傻子需要好好学学。

弟兄们！拿起武器！
texts.en:
The fool needs to be taught a lesson.

Skitskur'r! Weapons!

label.zh: 你们会见识到[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]军团的厉害。
label.en: You will know the military might of the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].
The pirates are destroyed by another empire

texts.zh:
[Root.GetRulerTitle]，我看到您一下子就除掉了那些海盗。

作为一名科学家，我痛恨争斗……但我也深知在那种情形下这是必需的。如果我落入那些海盗之手，想必待遇不会太好。
texts.en:
I see you made short work of the pirates, [Root.GetRulerTitle].
As a scientist, I abhor violence... But recognize that it may have been necessary in this case. I strongly suspect I would have been treated less than kindly at the hands of those pirates.

label.zh: 确实如此。现在有话快说吧。

responses.zh:
噢，好的。

就是……我不用细枝末节来烦扰您了，[Root.GetRulerTitle]，但是有一种观念，一切皆为虚妄。或者说我们所认知的真实其实并非如此，至少并非完全如此，甚至比其他事物更接近于虚妄。这也就是说，这一切——包括我，[Root.GetRulerTitle]您自己，以及我们认为是不可动摇的宇宙法则——都只不过是光的把戏而已。这个宇宙不过是镜花水月，是映像，抑或是全息投影，或是棱镜。终究只不过是散射了真正现实的迷人光线罢了。

明白了吗？这些光一定是从某个地方来的。从真实之窗来的。
responses.en:
Oh yes, of course.
There is... I will not bore you with the details [Root.GetRulerTitle], but there is this idea, if you will, that nothing is real. Or that what we think is real is not, that it is less real, less so than something else. That this, this is all - I, you yourself [Root.GetRulerTitle], the very laws of nature we consider absolute - nothing but tricks of the light. The universe as a reflection, hologram, or prism, simply breaking the brilliant rays of the truly real.

See? The light has to come from somewhere. Through the Window.

label.en: You are to return to [Root.Capital.GetName] immediately.

texts.zh:
威胁首席科学官的那些阳炎海盗已经被消灭了，不过不是出自我们之手。

首席正在向我们致意。
texts.en:
The Sunblaster Pirates threatening the Head of Research have been destroyed by some hand not our own.

The Head Physicist is hailing us.

title.zh: 浪迹星涯：无人机被击毁

texts.zh:
科学家留下的无人机似乎被某个人或者是某个东西击毁了。

我们应该抓住这个机会，寻找有关首席的线索。

一个特殊项目已经添加到情报日志中。
texts.en:
It seems the drones left behind by the Researcher have been destroyed, by something or someone.

We should seize this opportunity to pick up the Head's trail.

A Special Project has been added to the Situation Log.

texts.zh:
对不起，我的研究才刚刚开始。使命在召唤我，这是为了科学。

但是，为了表示我的诚意，请收下这些无人机吧，作为我送给[Root.GetName]的礼物。这些无人机是我在这个星系的外围发现的。经过彻底修理过后，我才发现它们根本不适合用作研究探测。
texts.en:
I think not, this is but the beginning. Duty calls, for science, and so on.

But please, as a token of my goodwill, take these drones. A donation to the [Root.GetName]. I found them drifting on the outskirts of this system, and only after extensive repairs did I realize that they are utterly unfit to function as research probes.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]理论科学委员会的主席和一架非常规科研船原型机一起消失了。

我们已经将他们的下落锁定到三个可能的地点，可以依次排查。
texts.en:
The Chair of the [Root.GetName]'s Abstract Sciences Board has gone missing along with an unorthodox Science Ship prototype.

Their current whereabouts have been narrowed down to three likely locations, to be investigated in turn.

summary.text:
# 浪迹星涯 / Wanderlust

- 分类 Category: C8 银河轶事 / C8 Galactic miscellany · 来源 Sources: events/country_events_2.txt:341-1868; events/game_start.txt:15; common/event_chains/00_event_chains_2.txt:12-41 · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

开局事件闸门以很低的权重（1）抽中。研究总督（科学家）弹出 country.1000 并被放逐，30天后 country.1001 开始第一条事件链，在首都1到5跳内标记三个搜索星系。

Drawn from the starting-event gate with a very low weight (1). The research councilor (a scientist) appears in country.1000 and is exiled; 30 days later country.1001 starts the first chain, marking three search systems 1-5 jumps from the capital.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

一、搜寻：舰队进入三个星系（任意顺序），前两次 country.1003“死胡同”，第三次 country.1005 找到科学官并进入对话（country.1010–1012）；他不耐烦后 country.1015 召来“碎片探测器”攻击。二、追击：击毁探测器（country.1020，他国击毁则 country.1022），启用“蛛丝马迹”项目，完成后 country.1025 开启第二条事件链，在3到8跳外标记一个星系；进入时 country.1030“遇上麻烦了”，阳炎海盗出现，科学官（country.1035）与海盗（country.1040）对话。三、对峙：付钱（country.1041）或开战（country.1042，击毁后 country.1045）；两条路都以与科学官的对话 country.1044/1045 收束，并经 country.1046 获得物理研究，country.1047 开启第三条事件链并标记最后星系。四、真相之窗：进入后 country.1050–1053 与科学官最后对话，country.1055 结束故事。

1) Search: fleets enter the three systems (any order); the first two give country.1003 "dead end", the third country.1005 finds the scientist and opens dialogue (country.1010-1012); when he gets fed up country.1015 sends "scrap probes". 2) Pursuit: destroy the probes (country.1020, or country.1022 if another empire does), enabling the "Trail of breadcrumbs" project; its completion country.1025 starts the second chain and marks a system 3-8 jumps away; entering gives country.1030 "In Trouble", the Sunblaster Pirates appear and the scientist (country.1035) and pirates (country.1040) talk. 3) Standoff: pay them off (country.1041) or fight (country.1042, then country.1045 once they die); both paths end in the scientist dialogue country.1044/1045, then country.1046 (physics research) and country.1047 which starts the third chain and marks the final system. 4) The window: entering gives country.1050-1053, the last conversation, and country.1055 ends the story.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

主要分支：探测器自己击毁或他国击毁；海盗付钱或开战（含他国消灭）。结局唯一，汇入 country.1055。

Main branches: probes killed by us or someone else; pirates paid off or fought (including killed by others). One ending, country.1055.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

付钱选项需要150能量及和平主义/物质主义伦理；排外者可有专属回应；开局条件见上。

Paying needs 150 energy and pacifist/materialist ethics; xenophobes get their own replies; start conditions above.
